title: Commercial agricultural product categories
description: Categories for agricultural subject classification and eligible commercial product offerings.
governanceNotes: A future Product entity represents a specific commercial offering and may reference only a COMMERCIAL_PRODUCT category.
CLASSIFICATION_ONLY categories provide article and event subject classification but cannot categorize a Product entity.
Commodity entities, prices, contracts and time series remain deferred to a later market-data phase.

terms.label: Crop products
terms.definition: A grouping of subject classifications for goods derived directly from cultivated crops.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize more specific crop-product classifications; exclude Product entities, commodity-market instruments and processed foods.

terms.label: Cereal products
terms.definition: Commercial grain and cereal offerings such as wheat, maize, rice and barley products.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include cereal goods as products; exclude commodity contracts, price series and substantially processed foods.

terms.label: Oilseed products
terms.definition: Commercial offerings based on oil-bearing seeds and their primary outputs.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include oilseeds and primary oils or meals; exclude finished consumer foods where oilseed identity is incidental.

terms.label: Pulse products
terms.definition: Commercial dry-legume offerings including beans, lentils, chickpeas and peas.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include pulses sold as agricultural products; exclude fresh vegetable legumes and commodity financial instruments.

terms.label: Fruit products
terms.definition: Commercial fresh or minimally processed fruit offerings.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include fruit where the agricultural identity remains primary; exclude formulated beverages and highly processed foods.

terms.label: Vegetable products
terms.definition: Commercial fresh or minimally processed vegetable offerings.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include vegetables offered as agricultural goods; exclude prepared meals and products where vegetable identity is incidental.

terms.label: Root and tuber products
terms.definition: Commercial offerings based on root and tuber crops such as potatoes and cassava.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include primary root and tuber goods; exclude highly processed starch products unless sold primarily as agricultural inputs.

terms.label: Sugar-crop products
terms.definition: Commercial offerings derived primarily from sugar cane, sugar beet or comparable sugar crops.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include crops and primary sugar outputs; exclude confectionery and general sweetened foods.

terms.label: Fiber-crop products
terms.definition: Commercial agricultural fibers such as cotton, flax and jute.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include primary agricultural fiber outputs; exclude finished textiles and synthetic fibers.

terms.label: Animal products
terms.definition: A grouping of subject classifications for goods derived from farmed terrestrial animals.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize more specific animal-product classifications; exclude Product entities, live-animal services and aquatic products.

terms.label: Meat products
terms.definition: Commercial meat and primary meat offerings from livestock or poultry.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include carcass and minimally processed meat products; exclude prepared meals and seafood.

terms.label: Dairy products
terms.definition: Commercial milk and milk-derived offerings.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include milk, cheese, butter and comparable dairy products; exclude plant-based substitutes.

terms.label: Poultry and egg products
terms.definition: Commercial poultry-meat and egg offerings.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include poultry and eggs as products; exclude other livestock meat and hatchery services.

terms.label: Aquatic products
terms.definition: Commercial fish, shellfish and other aquatic food offerings.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include capture and aquaculture products; exclude ornamental aquatic animals and general marine services.

terms.label: Forestry products
terms.definition: Commercial primary outputs from managed forests.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include timber and non-timber forest products; exclude finished furniture and conservation services.

terms.label: Agricultural input products
terms.definition: A grouping of commercial offering categories used in agricultural production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize specific input categories; exclude Product entities, advisory services and financial instruments.

terms.label: Seed products
terms.definition: Commercial seed and planting-material offerings intended for production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include certified and commercial propagation material; exclude harvested grain sold only for consumption.

terms.label: Fertilizer products
terms.definition: Commercial mineral, organic and biological nutrient products for agricultural use.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include products intended to supply plant nutrients; exclude general soil amendments without a nutrient function.

terms.label: Crop-protection products
terms.definition: Commercial products intended to prevent or control crop pests, diseases or weeds.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include chemical and biological crop-protection offerings; exclude diagnostic services and noncommercial control practices.

terms.label: Animal-feed products
terms.definition: Commercial feed, fodder, supplements and premixes for farmed animals.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include products intended for animal nutrition; exclude food intended for human consumption.

terms.label: Agricultural-machinery products
terms.definition: Commercial machinery and equipment offerings used in agricultural production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include tractors, implements and production equipment; exclude general vehicles and machinery without an agricultural purpose.

terms.label: Processed-food products
terms.definition: Commercial food offerings materially transformed from primary agricultural ingredients.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include packaged or formulated food offerings that may be represented as Product entities; exclude primary agricultural goods and restaurant services.
